The sheet records Status=cancelled/StartYear1=2022 for the whole row, sourced to a 2023 Earthjustice release about National Grid's withdrawal of the pipeline's fifth and final phase (the LNG-vaporizer connection at Greenpoint). THIS ONE WAS MISFILED IN THE HANDOFF as 'sheet Owner1 matches EIA operator'. It does not, and the reason is scope. GEM splits Northern Access 2016 into two rows -- P6008 is the (PA to NY) leg and P2575 is the (NY to ON) leg -- and EIA splits it the same way, with DIFFERENT operators: 'Northern Access 2016 Project (PA to NY)' carries Pipeline Operator Name = 'National Fuel Gas Supply Corp' (Aug 2026, sheet 'Historical Projects (1996-2024)', Excel row 1178; 101 mi, 497 MMcf/d, Cancelled -- matching this row's length and status), while 'Northern Access 2016 Project (NY to ON)' is the one that carries 'Empire Pipeline' (e.g. Oct 2025, sheet 'Natural Gas Pipeline Projects', Excel row 89). The pairing is stable across every release back to 2018-05. Matching on PipelineName instead of SegmentName is what makes 'Empire Pipeline' look like a hit -- addendum failure mode 3.
